ledger: man | shaving chin with electric razor | shaving forehead/temples then returning to chin | razor disappears from right hand between shots

findings.description: At 00:02, the man is seen in the mirror holding a razor in his right hand against his forehead while simultaneously holding another razor in his left hand at his temple. By 00:03, his right hand is flat against his forehead with no razor visible, while the left hand continues to shave. The razor in the right hand vanishes inexplicably between these moments.
